messages:
maya: Quick poll — what's the smallest semver bump that could conceivably fix a YAML parsing bug? :thinking_face:
jamie: Patch, obviously. 1.2.3 -> 1.2.4. We increment feelings.
kevin: Minor, if you squint. 1.2.3 -> 1.3.0 because YAML is dramatic.
olivia: Can we just release 1.2.3-alpha+yaml-fix and call it "emotional support release"? :stuck_out_tongue:
maya: real example: someone had this in prod and it broke everything:
```yaml
servers:
  - host: api
    port: 8080
    enabled: true
  metadata:
   owner: infra-team
```
notice the two-space indentation on owner vs 4 on others
jamie: classic. semver can't fix a tab vs space.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout started for service "config-loader" (release 1.2.4). :gear: :rocket:
kevin: Proposed new semver rule: any YAML bug => bump MAJOR by 0.1
olivia: I nominate "semver therapist" role to approve yaml fixes. :heart:
dev-ops: poll: thumbs up for 1.2.4 patch? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:
maya: :thumbsup: (me)
jamie: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
olivia: :thumbsup:
sre-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout successful. No regressions detected. :white_check_mark:
maya: conclusion: always lint before you semver.
